name: Kaggle
tagline: Dataset platform API for competitions, datasets, notebooks, and models
description: Official Kaggle REST API for programmatic access to competitions, datasets, kernels/notebooks, models, and user resources. Authenticate with API credentials from your account settings; used for listing/downloading datasets, submitting competition entries, and managing notebook workflows.

auth.details: API key via HTTP Basic Auth (username as username, key as password) or kaggle.json credentials file; generate key at Account Settings → Create New API Token

use_cases: search and list public datasets by keyword
download a dataset for offline analysis
